name: RClone Manager
blurb: A graphical interface for rclone that lets you manage cloud storage accounts without using the command line.
description:
A graphical interface for rclone that lets you manage cloud storage accounts without using the command line. Supports dozens of providers including Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, and S3.

Key features:

• Visual workflow builder: design multi-step automations with an interactive node-based canvas, triggers, logic, and notifications

• Quick Runs & Flow automation hub: one-click operation execution, CLI command import, and reusable templates

• Built-in file manager (Nautilus): browse, copy, move, rename, delete, archive, and preview remote files

• Rich media preview: support for images, videos, audio, PDFs, Markdown, and code with syntax highlighting

• Mount cloud storage as a local drive with VFS cache controls

• Automations: schedule operations using cron expressions or trigger transfers with real-time file system watchers

• Serve remote storage over HTTP or WebDAV

• Power management: prevents automatic system sleep while active transfers, mounts, or servers are running

• System tray integration and customizable keyboard shortcuts for quick control

• Theme support: dark and light modes with automatic system theme synchronization

• Encrypted configuration storage with full backup and restore support

• Multi-backend management with customizable per-operation profiles

Troubleshooting: If you encounter an "Invalid binary" error during setup, it is likely caused by an outdated system rclone binary. Go to Settings → Core, clear the rclone binary path, and click Save & Reset Engine. When prompted, let the app download and install the latest rclone version automatically.

For other issues such as a blank screen or freezes on Linux, refer to the Linux Troubleshooting Guide linked below.
